letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. 23 Feb feels like a secret bookmark in our story, a gentle reminder that our love only deepens with each passing season. I cherish our late‑night tea talks, your laugh echoing across continents, and the way your smile turns ordinary moments into gold. Thank you for being my compass, my home, and my endless adventure. I love you more than words can capture.
poem:
From desert dunes to river’s gleam,  
Your love’s the thread that weaves my dream.  
Together, jaan, we dance and sway,  
In every heart‑beat, you’re my day.
